items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I'd have Flood on trumpet, different ones.

ctx.x: And then he says some -- after that you led your own band.

Yeah, well, that's -- after that I went into the masonic fraternity, you know, all order them, by being a musician, and they gave something like the Shriners, they have this big potentates ball, boatride and this and that. So that's what kept me up on my horn. I'd have six, seven gigs a month. I'd have Flood on trumpet, different ones.
What would you do? Sort of have different size bands or --
